title: Policy Register (schema_version 2)
description: Who decided how hard each control bites, per enterprise, org, team, product, repository and environment tier. One format, two places: the CENTRAL register (policy/policy-registration.json in the kit, delivered by $/; holds enterprise/org/team/product/repository scopes, the orgs map and the repository map) and a REPOSITORY's own registration (.security/policy-registration.json on its protected default branch; scopes name only environment_tier; tighten-only). Neither present = the kit default, crawl: only secrets block. Precedence, most specific wins: kit default < enterprise < org < org+team < org+product < org+team+product < repository; within a level a scope with environment_tier ranks above one without. THE AUTHORITY FLOOR (KDEC-018): a narrower entry may only tighten; one that leaves the rung, a control or a registered deploy approval weaker than what is registered above it is POLICY_BELOW_AUTHORITY_FLOOR (BLOCKED), with or without a decision, and only the authority (enterprise or org scope) may soften the kit default deploy approval. Per-finding exceptions (secret_exceptions) are not rung changes and are unaffected. This schema is the shape; scripts/policy_registration.py --validate also refuses what a schema cannot say: duplicate keys and scopes (POLICY_REGISTER_CONFLICT), uat/prod departures without environment_reviewers (POLICY_DECISION_UNATTRIBUTED), below-floor entries, non-monotone tiers, expired decisions.

schema_version.description: 2 = the multi-scope register. 1 (the per-repository cell format) is retired and refused.

proposed_by.description: What proposed this register (for example a team-type analysis harness and its run). A proposal resolves only once a person signs it off.

by.description: The named person who signed the register off.

environment_names.description: GitHub environment name -> environment_tier, for target_environment values that are not tier names.

orgs.description: CENTRAL ONLY. org -> the enterprise it belongs to (KDEC-018). An enterprise scope binds every repository of every org mapped to it; an org this map does not name belongs to no enterprise. Org names compare case-insensitively.

repositories.description: CENTRAL ONLY. owner/name -> the team and product it belongs to. The org is the owner.

numbers.description: Owner-configured numbers (SLA periods and the like); nothing in the kit defaults any of them -- except max_exception_renewals, whose kit default is 2.

max_exception_renewals.description: KDEC-018: how many times one exception (a secret exception, a softening decision, a deploy's version-gap exception) may be renewed -- the number of prior grants in its `renews`. CENTRAL ONLY (the authority's scope). Kit default 2. Never unlimited: 0 means no renewal, 5 bounds one exception at six grants. Over it: EXCEPTION_RENEWAL_LIMIT.

route.description: PROCEED is not settable: a finding must never read as a pass.

renews.description: KDEC-018 item 4: this exception's PRIOR grants -- its history. Empty or absent is a first exception. Shown wherever the exception is applied or resurfaced ('previously excepted N time(s) since <date>, tickets ..., approvers ...'); more prior grants than numbers.max_exception_renewals refuse it (EXCEPTION_RENEWAL_LIMIT). scripts/exception_history.py.

scope.description: An enterprise scope names only enterprise (and optionally environment_tier); every other central scope names an org or a repository.

enterprise.description: CENTRAL ONLY. An enterprise named by the orgs map: the top authority (KDEC-018).

controls.description: Per control class or scanner job, the weakest routing_result it may contribute. secrets, secret-scan and malicious-deps accept only BLOCKED.

secret_exceptions.description: Owner ruling 2026-10-22: ONE secret finding made advisory by a requested, ticketed, logged exception. Each item names the finding's fingerprint (the security report's `fp`, 12 lowercase hex -- never secrets as a class, a scanner or a wildcard), a work-item ticket key <PROJECT>-<digits> (scripts/ticket_reference.py; numbers.ticket_min_digits/ticket_max_digits when set), an explanation, the named approver, an unexpired expiry, and environment_reviewers (here or on the entry's decision) when it applies at uat/prod. The shape only: scripts/policy_registration.py refuses a defective item by name (SECRET_EXCEPTION_NOT_FINDING_SCOPED, _UNTICKETED, _UNATTRIBUTED, _EXPIRED) and the secret still blocks. A class-wide softening of secrets stays CHERRY_PICK_BELOW_FLOOR.

deploy_approval.description: What the deploy verifies on the GitHub environment it runs in (read-only). uat/prod default to one required reviewer with self-review prevented.

approver_groups.description: Reviewer teams (slugs) of which ONE must be a required reviewer of the environment.

ai_review.description: An AI review comments on pull requests. Advisory only: never a gate, never an approval.

environment_reviewers.description: Required for an entry that changes enforcement at uat or prod (a uat/prod tier, or no tier).
